final: SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scanfeatures f2 JOIN sites s2 ON f2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE f2.traitcount > 489) AS fraction FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY fraction IS NULL, fraction DESC LIMIT 10
